settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: lthn · v0.2.0-rc1
settings.panel_general_desc: App-wide defaults — what to show at launch, which language to speak, theme.
settings.panel_models_desc: Where lthn looks for models and which one loads at startup.
settings.panel_runner_desc: Provider routes the runner serves. Read-only; edit ~/Lethean/conf/lthn.yaml to add or change a route, then restart lthn.
settings.panel_api_desc: HTTP server for OpenAI-compatible clients. Off by default; nothing leaves this Mac unless you turn it on.
settings.panel_telemetry_desc: Process metrics shown in the tray + live-telemetry window. Local only; nothing leaves the device.
settings.panel_integrations_desc: Connected clients reading from the local lthn API. Full surface lives in the dedicated Integrations window.
settings.panel_about_desc: What's running — version, runtime, and where the source lives.
settings.row_startwindow_hint: If on, the unified app shell opens at launch alongside the tray. Off = tray-only until you click in.
settings.row_language_hint: Sets the language for the WebView surfaces. Stored locally; persists across restarts.
settings.row_modeldir_hint: Canonical Lethean layout — visible in Finder, safe to inspect.
settings.row_defaultmodel_hint: Configured runner route — picked first when the runner starts.
settings.row_defaultmodel_empty: No routes configured. Add one via lthn config routes.NAME.kind=…
settings.row_quantisation_hint: Pick the smallest quant your hardware comfortably runs. Applied when the runner loads a fresh model.
settings.row_sampling_hint: Per-model overrides live in the model browser.
settings.row_apikey_hint: Required for any client connecting to the local server.
settings.row_interval_hint: How often the tray polls the runner. 2s is the calm-presence default.
settings.row_heap_hint: Rolling window the sparkline draws from.
settings.row_power_hint: Requires the XPC helper (planned). Off today.
settings.row_openint_hint: Manage Claude Code / OpenCode / Codex / Copilot / Raycast wiring.
settings.row_version_hint: Binary release tag baked at build time.
settings.empty_routes: No routes configured. The runner falls back to an echo stub — useful for sanity checks but nothing real will answer.
settings.footer: Changes apply immediately · ⌘W to close · the runner keeps running

welcome.subtitle: step %s of 3
welcome.step1_title: Where shall we keep your models?
welcome.step1_body: A folder on this Mac. Models can be big — pick somewhere with room. We default to your home directory; change it if you have a faster volume.
welcome.step1_layout_hint: Canonical Lethean layout · visible in Finder · safe to inspect
welcome.step2_title: Pick a model to start with.
welcome.step2_body: Three small models that run comfortably on Apple Silicon. You can add more from the model browser anytime.
welcome.step3_title: Want to wire it into your tools?
welcome.step3_body: lthn speaks the OpenAI-compatible API on %s. We can drop the endpoint into these configs for you. The only outbound action lthn ever takes without you asking.
welcome.step3_empty: No supported clients detected on this Mac. You can always wire one up later from Settings → Integrations.
